title: Appearance
description: How your menu looks to guests. Changes show in the preview right away; guests see them after you save.
themes_hint: Start from a ready-made look, then adjust it.
contrast_light: This colour is hard to read on white. Guests will see a darker shade of it so the text stays readable.

editorial.name: A · Warm editorial
editorial.hint: Big photos first and serif headings, like a printed café menu.

grid.name: B · Fresh grid
grid.hint: Your name on the banner and two photo cards per row, like a food app.

bistro.name: C · Quiet bistro
bistro.hint: A calm list with small photos on the right. Quickest to scan.

images_hint: The cover appears at the top of your menu. Use a wide photo.
saved: Appearance saved. Guests see it now.
preview_hint: Preview of your menu on a phone (not saved yet).
